sentences.text: 9. I have carefully perused the allegations in the FIR and the  material on record.
Evidently, the alleged offences have their  genesis in the partnership disputes.
It appears that the trigger for  the dispute was purported release of a film " Haddi " on the OTT  platform.

An order passed by this Court in Commercial  Arbitration Petition (L) No.24521 of 2023 dated 4 th September  2023 indicates that the Court was not persuaded to grant ad-  D.A.ETHAPE 5 of 7 ::: Uploaded on - 19/08/2024 ::: Downloaded on - 23/08/2024 14:38:01  ABA-94-97-2024.do  interim relief of stay to the release of the said film.
